cases.input: Convertible note N becomes preferred shares after conversion.
cases.expect: Investment identity persists while predecessor and successor positions retain lineage.

cases.input: An approved investment has a commitment but no funded position.
cases.expect: The investment remains identifiable without inventing a holding.

cases.input: Every listed position automatically creates an Investment root.
cases.expect: Creation is rejected without independent mandate and lifecycle.
cases.violates: Creation is rejected without independent mandate and lifecycle.

cases.input: An undrawn commitment is counted as current owned quantity.
A valuation amount overwrites position quantity and cost.
Closing the final position deletes the investment record.
cases.expect: Deletion is rejected; exited lineage remains resolvable.
cases.violates: Deletion is rejected; exited lineage remains resolvable.

cases.input: INV-1's note position converts to preferred shares on 2026-08-15.
cases.expect: INV-1's identity and revision history persist; a participation revision records the new instrument version and position references with effectiveFrom; prior revisions remain resolvable.

cases.input: Every position of INV-1 is derecognized on 2026-09-30 with no retained interest or obligation and the governance record open.
cases.expect: Status is exactly exited; retained is not asserted; all revisions remain resolvable.

cases.input: Every position of INV-1 is derecognized on 2026-09-30 and an escrow and indemnity obligation remains outstanding.
cases.expect: Status is exactly retained; exited is not asserted.

cases.input: INV-1 is recorded as both exited and retained at 2026-09-30.
cases.expect: Rejected. The two states are mutually exclusive at any instant.

cases.input: One of INV-1's two positions is derecognized on 2026-09-30; the other remains outstanding.
A participation revision is appended to INV-1 after status closed.
cases.expect: Rejected. closed is terminal and reachable only from exited or retained.

cases.input: INV-1 carries no mandateRef and an inline mandateAssertion with a WM-ORG-018 authority reference, mandate statement, effectiveFrom and evidence digest.
cases.expect: Accepted while no mandate master is allocated, with the migration hold recorded.

cases.input: INV-1 carries a mandateRef to a mandate master that is not allocated in this dossier.
cases.expect: Rejected. A reference to an unallocated master is not satisfiable; inline mandateAssertion is required.

cases.input: INV-2 is a direct real-asset participation with subjectKind underlying-asset.
cases.expect: Accepted as identifiable with no security, register, custody account or investee organization fabricated; the unbound underlying-asset master hold is recorded.

cases.input: INV-2 records a single subject reference with no subjectKind.
INV-2's underlying-asset subject is entered into an organizational control or consolidation denominator.
cases.expect: Rejected. Only subjectKind investee-organization with a WM-ORG-001 reference may participate in a relationship, control or consolidation assertion.
cases.violates: No unsafe inference from exposure to organization

cases.input: A participation revision restates predecessor and successor position lineage with values differing from WM-ECO-038.
cases.expect: Rejected. Investment masters only the effective-dated linkage set and never restates, derives or supersedes externally mastered lineage.

cases.input: A listed-equity portfolio row is used to create an Investment root with no mandate, stage or governed participation.
cases.expect: Rejected. Portfolio membership is a grouping over holdings and never identifies an Investment.
cases.violates: Participation identity requires governed mandate and lifecycle

holds: Expectations are reviewable-draft adjudications over non-canonical bases and assert no conformance, installability or standards alignment.
